node_id.description: The node this record belongs to, as contracts/node-identity.schema.json names it. Required so a record read on its own says which node it is from; a console that holds a peer's records through a crossing must never present them as its own (decisions/0039). Added 2026-08-25: the record carried this field and the schema did not, so contract.foreign_records could not see a foreign one at all and additionalProperties:false would have rejected the honest projection.

session_id.description: The exact operator session that emitted this post. Separate sessions remain distinguishable even when they share one operator.

binding_id.description: The Human Binding or Model Binding carried by the emitting session. It is provenance, not authority.

principal_id.description: Durable principal carried by the emitting session when known. Null is an explicit unresolved identity, never an invitation to infer one from actor_id, binding_id, or session_id.

content_address.description: Address of the immutable post payload; a post is never rewritten, corrections are new posts or counter-records.

mentions.description: Operator ids named in the post; each yields a MENTION notification resolving back to this post's address and digest.

proposal_id.description: Set when the post enters the kernel as a Proposal; a MODEL post that claims anything must carry one.

receipt_id.description: Receipt of the post transition; a human post and a model post in one thread take the same transition and yield reconcilable receipts.
